fullPassage: Young Change-Makers Shaping the Future There are a lot of things that fill us with hope for the future: technology, science, accountable leaders, and nonprofit organizations committed to doing good. However, few things give us more hope for the future than young people. Some young people are already working toward solutions for the problems their communities and the world are facing. Let’s look at three inspirational examples of these young people. Combating Online Hate with ReThink Trisha Prabhu, a young computer scientist from the U.S., is fighting cyberbullying with her innovative application ReThink. ReThink is a virtual keyboard that uses artificial intelligence to detect potentially hurtful text messages before they are sent and prompts young people to pause and reconsider their words. When a user types a message that contains potentially offensive language, such as “I hate you,” ReThink prompts: “Hold on! Are you sure you want to say that?” or, “Remember. You are what you type!” In 2014, when Trisha was just thirteen years old, she read the tragic news of a twelve-year-old girl who had been cyberbullied for over a year and a half. Shocked at the story, she decided to prevent cyberbullying by using technology and created ReThink. ReThink has been used by schools and organizations worldwide and has successfully raised awareness on cyberbullying. It has helped young people make better decisions in digital space where people could easily be unkind toward each other. In fact, it has been found that when using ReThink, adolescents change their minds 93% of the time and decide not to post offensive messages. Inventing with Discarded Electronic Parts Kelvin Doe, a self-taught inventor and engineer from Sierra Leone, has been fascinated with electronics since childhood. He would often do experiments with discarded electronics he found in trash cans to create his own inventions. In 2009, at the young age of thirteen, Kelvin built his own FM radio station by using a transmitter he made from discarded electronic parts. In 2014, during the time when an Ebola outbreak affected Africa, Kelvin’s radio station proved to be invaluable. With schools closed, his radio station provided educational programs to students over the radio. This was especially important in his country, where the radio was the main source of media. Kelvin also improved the lives of people around him by providing affordable resources. He invented a battery capable of powering homes and small businesses, designed a generator that runs on salt water, and constructed a windmill to supply electricity to his community. Helping Homeless People Rebuild Their Lives John Michael Stagliano is a young social activist from the U.S. who founded Home Again in 2016. It is a nonprofit organization that offers furniture and household essentials to families and individuals transitioning from homelessness to stable housing. He says, “For people who have lived in their cars, in and out of shelters, and in the woods, to be home again is a triumph, a sense of peace, and something to be celebrated.” John’s journey began in 2015. At the age of twelve, he volunteered at a local shelter where people in need were staying. He learned that many of the shelter residents worked hard to rent houses and trailers but faced difficulties in furnishing their new homes upon moving in. This prompted John to decide to do something for those transitioning out of homelessness. Needing donations to gather essential items to help them, John reached out to his family, friends, and neighbors. As word of his efforts spread, donations began to rush in. So John was able to help more people get settled. He said, “I never knew the impact that a simple couch or a kitchen table could have. Furniture can restore the dignity of a family.” Trisha Prabhu, Kelvin Doe, and John Michael Stagliano are all examples of young social activists who have made significant contributions to society. Their innovative efforts to solve social problems demonstrate the power of technology, commitment, and individual initiative. Their stories serve as an inspiration for young people around the world to pursue their passions and make a difference in their communities. As young innovators and social activists keep appearing, they will undoubtedly make the world a better place.

Let’s look at three inspirational examples of these young people.  Combating Online Hate with ReThink Trisha Prabhu, a young computer scientist from the U. S. , is <u>fighting</u> cyberbullying with her innovative application ReThink.  ReThink is a virtual keyboard that uses artificial intelligence to detect potentially hurtful text messages before they are sent and prompts young people to pause and reconsider their words.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 fighting와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① battling: 맞서 싸우는 ← 정답
❌ ② avoiding: 피하는 (반대 방향)
❌ ③ ignoring: 무시하는
❌ ④ praising: 칭찬하는
det.tip: fighting cyberbullying = battling = 사이버불링에 맞서 싸우다

questions.passage: Young Change-Makers Shaping the Future There are a lot of things that fill us with hope for the future: technology, science, accountable leaders, and nonprofit organizations committed to doing good. S. , is fighting cyberbullying with her innovative application ReThink.  ReThink is a virtual keyboard that uses artificial intelligence to detect potentially hurtful text messages before they are sent and prompts young people to pause and <u>reconsider</u> their words.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 reconsider와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① ignore(무시하다): 다시 생각하는 것과 정반대의 의미
✅ ② rethink(다시 생각하다): reconsider와 같은 뜻으로 정답
❌ ③ forget(잊다): 재고하는 것과 무관한 의미
❌ ④ repeat(반복하다): 다시 생각하는 것과 다른 의미
det.tip: pause and reconsider their words = rethink = 말을 다시 생각하다

questions.passage: Young Change-Makers Shaping the Future There are a lot of things that fill us with hope for the future: technology, science, accountable leaders, and nonprofit organizations committed to doing good.  However, few things give us more hope for the future than young people.  Some young people are already working toward solutions for the problems their communities and the world are facing.  Let’s look at three inspirational examples of these young people.  Combating Online Hate with ReThink Trisha Prabhu, a young computer scientist from the U. S. , is fighting cyberbullying with her innovative application ReThink.  ReThink is a virtual keyboard that uses artificial intelligence to detect potentially hurtful text messages before they are sent and prompts young people to pause and reconsider their words.  When a user types a message that contains potentially offensive language, such as “I hate you,” ReThink prompts: “Hold on!  Are you sure you want to say that? ” or, “Remember.  You are what you type! ” In 2014, when Trisha was just thirteen years old, she read the tragic news of a twelve-year-old girl who had been cyberbullied for over a year and a half.  Shocked at the story, she decided to prevent cyberbullying by using technology and created ReThink.  ReThink has been used by schools and organizations worldwide and has successfully raised awareness on cyberbullying.  It has helped young people make better decisions in digital space where people could easily be unkind toward each other.  In fact, it has been found that when using ReThink, adolescents change their minds 93% of the time and decide not to post offensive messages.  Inventing with Discarded Electronic Parts Kelvin Doe, a self-taught inventor and engineer from Sierra Leone, has been fascinated with electronics since childhood.  He would often do experiments with discarded electronics he found in trash cans to create his own inventions.  In 2009, at the young age of thirteen, Kelvin built his own FM radio station by using a transmitter he made from discarded electronic parts.  In 2014, during the time when an Ebola outbreak affected Africa, Kelvin’s radio station proved to be invaluable.  With schools closed, his radio station provided educational programs to students over the radio.  This was especially important in his country, where the radio was the main source of media.  Kelvin also improved the lives of people around him by providing affordable resources.  He <u>invented</u> a battery capable of powering homes and small businesses, designed a generator that runs on salt water, and constructed a windmill to supply electricity to his community.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 invented와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① destroyed: 파괴했다 (반대)
❌ ② copied: 베꼈다
✅ ③ devised: 고안했다·발명했다 ← 정답
❌ ④ imagined: 상상했다 (실제 제작과 다름)
det.tip: invented a battery = devised = 배터리를 발명·고안하다

questions.passage:
(A) Kelvin designed a generator that <u>runs</u> on salt water to supply electricity to his community. The machine keeps working even during long power outages.
(B) Every morning before school, Kelvin <u>runs</u> along the beach near his home. He enjoys the exercise and the fresh sea air.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B) 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 runs의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① (A)는 달리다가 아니라 작동하다
❌ ② (A)는 흐르다가 아님
❌ ③ (B)는 운영하다가 아니라 달리다
✅ ④ (A) runs on salt water = (기계가) 작동하다·가동되다, (B) runs along the beach = 달리다 ← 정답
det.tip: run(s): (A) (기계가) 작동하다 / (B) 달리다

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"a person who works hard to bring about social or political change"

det.analysis:
❌ ① scientist: 과학자
❌ ② engineer: 기술자
❌ ③ inventor: 발명가
✅ ④ activist: 사회·정치적 변화를 이루려 애쓰는 사람, 운동가 ← 정답
det.tip: activist = young social activist = 사회 변화를 위해 힘쓰는 사람

questions.passage: ReThink has been used by schools and organizations worldwide and has successfully __________ (raise) awareness on cyberbullying. It has helped young people make better decisions in digital space.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: raise(원형) → raised(과거분사): 'has + 과거분사' 현재완료 형태. 'has successfully raised'로 '성공적으로 (인식을) 높여 왔다'는 완료·계속의 의미를 나타낸다
det.tip: 현재완료 has + p.p.: has raised

questions.passage: __________ (need) donations to gather essential items to help them, John reached out to his family, friends, and neighbors. As word of his efforts spread, donations began to rush in.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: need(원형) → Needing(현재분사): 'Because he needed donations'를 분사구문으로 줄인 형태. 주어(John)가 능동적으로 '필요로 하는' 것이므로 현재분사 Needing을 쓴다
det.tip: 분사구문 현재분사: Needing donations, John reached out...

questions.passage: Young Change-Makers Shaping the Future There are a lot of things that fill us with hope for the future: technology, science, accountable leaders, and nonprofit organizations committed to doing good. Let’s look at three inspirational examples of these young people.  Combating Online Hate with ReThink Trisha Prabhu, a young computer scientist from the U. S. , is fighting cyberbullying with her innovative application ReThink. When a user types a message that contains potentially offensive language, such as “I hate you,” ReThink prompts: “Hold on!  Are you sure you want to say that? ” or, “Remember.  You are what you type! ” In 2014, when Trisha was just thirteen years old, she read the tragic news of a twelve-year-old girl who had been cyberbullied for over a year and a half.  Shocked at the story, she decided to prevent cyberbullying by using technology and created ReThink.  ReThink has been used by schools and organizations worldwide and has successfully raised awareness on cyberbullying.  It has helped young people make better decisions in digital space where people could easily be unkind toward each other.  In fact, it has been found that when using ReThink, adolescents change their minds 93% of the time and decide not to post offensive messages.  Inventing with Discarded Electronic Parts Kelvin Doe, a self-taught inventor and engineer from Sierra Leone, has been fascinated with electronics since childhood.  He would often do experiments with discarded electronics he found in trash cans to create his own inventions.  In 2009, at the young age of thirteen, Kelvin built his own FM radio station by using a transmitter he made from discarded electronic parts.  In 2014, during the time when an Ebola outbreak affected Africa, Kelvin’s radio station proved to be invaluable.  With schools closed, his radio station provided educational programs to students over the radio.  This was especially important in his country, where the radio was the main source of media.  Kelvin also improved the lives of people around him by providing affordable resources.  He invented a battery capable of powering homes and small businesses, designed a generator that runs on salt water, and constructed a windmill to supply electricity to his community.  Helping Homeless People Rebuild Their Lives John Michael Stagliano is a young social activist from the U. S.  who founded Home Again in 2016.  It is a nonprofit organization that offers furniture and household essentials to families and individuals transitioning from homelessness to stable housing.  He says, “For people who have lived in their cars, in and out of shelters, and in the woods, to be home again is a triumph, a sense of peace, and something to be celebrated. ” John’s journey began in 2015.  At the age of twelve, he volunteered at a local shelter where people in need were staying.  He learned that many of the shelter residents worked hard to rent houses and trailers but faced difficulties in furnishing their new homes upon moving in.  This prompted John to decide to do something for those transitioning out of homelessness.  Needing donations to gather essential items to help them, John reached out to his family, friends, and neighbors.  As word of his efforts spread, donations began to rush in.  So John was able to help more people get settled.  He said, “I never knew the impact that a simple couch or a kitchen table could have.  Furniture can restore the dignity of a family. ” Trisha Prabhu, Kelvin Doe, and John Michael Stagliano are all examples of young social activists who have made significant contributions to society.  Their innovative efforts to solve social problems demonstrate the power of technology, commitment, and individual initiative.  Their stories serve as an inspiration for young people around the world to pursue their passions and __________ in their communities.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① make a difference: 변화를 만들다 ← 정답
❌ ② take a break: 쉬다 부적합
❌ ③ earn a living: 생계를 꾸리다 부적합
❌ ④ keep a secret: 비밀을 지키다 부적합
det.tip: pursue their passions and make a difference in their communities: 열정을 좇고 지역사회에 변화를 만들다
